death.place: Plymouth Township, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, USA

summary: John's 3rd great-grandmother; Irish-born, buried St. Vincent de Paul, Larksville.
bio:
Alice Comerford (c.1835 Ireland – 18 Feb 1876) was buried at St. Vincent de Paul Cemetery, Larksville. Comerford is a characteristic surname of north Kilkenny and the Slieveardagh border — the Heffernans' district (speculative surname geography only). A John Comerford household from Ireland lived next to the Pringles in the 1880 Plymouth census.

1870 census: Alice Murphy, 35, keeping house, born Ireland, mother of seven children at home including one-month-old twins Martin and Thomas ([R4-S1]). She died in 1876 (FS) when the twins were about six.
